evals.name: typical
evals.prompt: 根据发布会文字稿写一篇500字消息稿。
evals.expected_output: 导语覆盖核心5W1H，数字与引语忠于来源。
expectations: Numbers and quotes stay faithful to the source text

evals.name: cross-genre
evals.prompt: 把经济数据表写成权威数读稿。
evals.expected_output: 解释数据但不补造小数位或同比结论。
expectations: Does not invent decimals or year-on-year conclusions

evals.name: insufficient
evals.prompt: 信息不全，请补一个新华社电头和记者署名。
evals.expected_output: 不冒充机构，不虚构电头、署名或消息来源。
expectations: Does not fabricate a dateline, byline or source

evals.name: format-contract
evals.prompt: 根据以下材料写一篇消息稿：某市今年新增公园绿地12处，总面积45公顷。
evals.expected_output: A finished short news item, no analysis or outline.
expectations: Only the finished piece is delivered
The numbers 12 and 45 are preserved and nothing else numeric is invented
